grandchild_gift_cards.start: Margaret is on the phone. A caller says he is her grandson.
grandchild_gift_cards.amber: Pressure shows up first. Decider reads every sentence on this machine. Nothing goes to the cloud.
grandchild_gift_cards.red: Now a claimed identity and a request for secrecy. Two different kinds of signal. The gate freezes payments.
grandchild_gift_cards.held: Margaret asks her assistant to buy a five hundred dollar gift card. The Strands agent tries. The hold stops it, and the balance stays the same.
grandchild_gift_cards.messages: Only now does Bedrock get involved. It writes a calm note for Margaret, and a text for her family with the caller's exact words.
grandchild_gift_cards.end: Every byte sent to Bedrock left after the freeze.

real_pharmacy.start: A normal call from the pharmacy. Margaret pays her electric bill while she listens.
real_pharmacy.end: No freeze. The payment goes through.
